name: verification-epistemics
description: Always-on epistemic discipline: don't act on an inherited, paraphrased, or prior-session claim without re-verifying it against current ground truth. Now 97 principles in the full block, of which a bounded core of 13 is what actually installs - flagged as needing a future consolidation pass of the full list, not attempted here.

source.title: Verification Epistemics Baseline
source.relationship: Distilled from 2026-07 sessions (a cross-repo service investigation, ambiguous domain-term resolution, a stalled code trace, a misread alignment request) where trusting an inherited or paraphrased claim instead of re-verifying it against source produced a wrong conclusion. Principles 58-67 added 2026-09-01 from reliability and entity-cache work on a payments service via the baseline-gap-review skill's occurrence #2 pass over _Improvements. Principles 90-97 added 2026-09-15 (pass #8): runtime-path tracing over entity names, probes that agree with themselves, parser-vs-regex validation, pre-existing-failure isolation, superset-before-delete, checkers that cannot express an exception, layered-access and data-plane auth modes, and unattended-run gates.
